edits.value: Backend and data engineer with six years of Python and Java work shipping production services and pipelines behind well-tested code and GitHub Actions CI/CD gates. Rebuilt a 200GB nightly warehouse load with Python, SQL, and change data capture, cutting the window from 6 hours to 45 minutes, and tuned a distributed 40-service platform for latency, cutting p95 reads 45%. Built DocQuery, a Python service that answers engineering questions over embedded wiki pages through an LLM API, cutting onboarding-question turnaround for 15 new hires from about 2 days to same day.

Added a Redis cache with a 5-minute TTL and a write-time invalidation hook in front of the PostgreSQL cart and pricing reads, cutting p95 read latency 45% and database CPU usage 30% during peak shipping weeks.
